event.desc: The concert was repeated the following day.

history.p: When Gade finished "Gefion" in the late summer of 1869, he apparently handed over the vocal score to the music publishers Wilhelm Hansen but they never published it. Only the choral parts were published four years later. "Gefion" was only performed twice during Gade's life time.

termList.term: Music for vocal soloists and instruments with or without choir

incipText.p: Da Asaskokke i tætte Flokke fra Østen rede
Gefion, du Ranke! Gefion, du Ranke! Bliv her at sanke Blomster hver Sommer
Så tog hun Ploven med Ædilstene og pløied Skoven
Hil Gefion Dise! Dig lød min Vise

physLoc.identifier: C II, 6 Gades Samling 286 (Kapsel F - J)

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in blue cardboard cover with label pasted on the front cover: "Gefion / Digt af A. Oehlenschläger / for / Solo, Chor & Orchester af / Niels W. Gade". Written in brown ink. Paper: 20 staves. Last two pages blank. At the bottom of the first page stamped: "Wilhelm Hansens Musikforlag". Enclosed a blue envolope with the Danish text in Gade's hand and a German translation by "Aschlund"?.

titlePage.p: Gefion / (Digt af Oehlenschläger.) / Concertst. for Baryton Solo / Chor & Orchester / Niels W. Gade / Op 51. / op. 54. [added in pencil in foreign hand] / Aug. - Septbr. 1869.

physDesc.physMedium: 3 bifolios and 2 single folios. Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. Title page and verso unnumbered. Paginated 1-14 from first music page. After the last bar dated "23 Septr 1869". The title page is stamped "WILHELM HANSENS MUSIK-FORLAG" althoug they never published the work.
